outcome.improving: fractional RMS with recovered currents is strictly smaller than fractional RMS without them

predictor_definitions.gauged_boundary_discrepancy_fractional_r: labelled grid-border flux minus released-current coil flux after the single plasma-subtraction additive gauge, divided by the labelled whole-grid flux range
predictor_definitions.labelled_lcfs_elongation: labelled LCFS vertical bounding span divided by radial bounding span
predictor_definitions.plasma_current_a: signed total current of the label-derived cell-filament projection
predictor_definitions.recovery_relative_residual: gauge-free L2 residual of the five-current boundary recovery
predictor_definitions.without_recovered_currents_fractional_rm: free-boundary extracted-profile residual using released currents

ranking.crossover: midpoint between adjacent observed predictor values maximizing balanced accuracy, considering both improving-above and improving-below directions
ranking.primary: orientation-invariant ROC AUC, reported also as absolute rank-biserial separation equal to 2*AUC-1
ranking.tie_break: higher balanced accuracy, then declared predictor order; within one predictor choose the numerically smallest threshold and improving-above before improving-below

selection.polarity_screen: exclude every shot in the landed 603-shot affected population before reading its row
selection.rule: take the first twenty lexicographic shots from the existing unaffected recovery cohort, then positions 0, 3 and 7 from each shot's eight score-independent evenly spaced diverted frames
